name: Yasuhisa Nashiro
source:
Yasuhisa Nashiro is an artificial one-eyed ghoul who impeded Ken Kaneki's pursuit of Madam A alongside her twin sister Kurona, who knew her as Shiro (シロ, lit. White).

[From [url=http://tokyoghoul.wikia.com/wiki/Nashiro_Yasuhisa]Tokyo Ghoul Wikia[/url]]
